title: The Apple Leak Absolutely NO ONE Noticed
lead: Apple just did the unthinkable -- a radical redesign leak that changes everything.
body: It is... a complete disaster. For years, we expected a minor upgrade, but this leak reveals a massive shift.
First, they removed the charging port entirely! Yes, it is completely gone -- leaving only wireless magnetic connection.
But the worst part? The price has soared by an absolute fortune! Everyone is furious... and no one is talking about it.
If this is the future of smartphones, then get ready -- because everything we knew... is about to change.
